faqs.q: What should I do if I suspect identity theft, scams, or cybercrime?
faqs.a: You can report identity theft, scams, or cybercrime using the dedicated Service NSW link.

faqs.q: How can I get help if my personal information has been breached or if my documents were stolen?
faqs.a: Support is available for personal information breaches, stolen documents, and fraud. You can also get a free credit report or apply for a credit ban.

faqs.q: Where can I find advice on staying safe online and protecting my family?
faqs.a: There are guides and advice available to help you protect yourself and be cyber secure, including resources for individuals and families.
